en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a Swedish town with buildings scattered across a hillside, a bridge crossing a river, and sawmill logs floating in the water. There is printed red text at the top that says 'Sundsvall. Norrmalm och Stadsbacken.' The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence, a Swedish postage stamp with King Gustav V, and postmarks. The address includes Swedish place names.
